answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, earned upward only through verified work. A newcomer starts in a supervised grove of low-value tasks, where each delivery attested by its counterparty slowly raises its limit. Reaching high-value trade is like leaving a sheltered karst inlet for the open wharf: it needs a long, unbroken record plus a bond so large that a hundred fake identities cost a hundred bonds, while one Sybil caught cheating loses its whole stake. Honest agents keep their bond; attackers pay per identity and gain nothing.
